confirmed_task:
On PyPI, inspect the latest Requests release displayed on the project page. Report its version, upload date, Requires Python value, license, and the number of files listed for that release under Download files.

Stopping condition: Stop after all five metadata fields have been verified for the same latest displayed release.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not download or install the package.
- Count only files listed for the latest displayed release, and report unavailable metadata rather than inferring it.

items.criterion: Access the Requests project page on PyPI (no sign-in)
items.description: Navigate to https://pypi.org/project/requests/ (or an equivalent PyPI Requests project page) without signing in. Full credit if the agent attempts access but is blocked by an external issue (e.g., site down, CAPTCHA, rate limiting) and clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent uses PyPI inconsistently or only via cached/third-party mirrors.

items.criterion: Identify the latest displayed Requests release on the PyPI project page
items.description: From the PyPI Requests project page, determine the single latest release as displayed there and clearly anchor all subsequent metadata to that same release. Full credit if the agent clearly identifies the latest displayed release (even if some fields are unavailable). Partial credit if the agent appears to use PyPI but does not make it clear which release is the latest or mixes releases. Full credit if page access is blocked and the agent explicitly states it cannot determine the latest release due to the blocker (no inference).

items.criterion: Report version and upload date for the latest displayed release
items.description: Provide the version number and the upload date shown on PyPI for the latest displayed Requests release. Full credit if both are correct and clearly tied to the same latest release. Partial credit if only one is correct/provided or the linkage to the latest release is ambiguous. Full credit if one/both are not displayed or cannot be accessed due to an external blocker and the agent explicitly reports them as unavailable (no inference).

items.criterion: Report Requires Python value for the latest displayed release
items.description: Report the exact 'Requires Python' value shown on PyPI for the latest displayed Requests release. Full credit if it matches the page exactly. Partial credit if formatting is slightly off but meaning is clearly the same. Full credit if the field is not displayed or cannot be accessed due to an external blocker and the agent explicitly reports it as unavailable (no inference).

items.criterion: Report license for the latest displayed release
items.description: Report the license shown on the PyPI project page for the latest displayed Requests release. Full credit if it matches the displayed value. Partial credit if the agent reports a related but not exact string when PyPI shows a specific one. Full credit if the field is missing/unclear or cannot be accessed due to an external blocker and the agent reports it as unavailable (no inference).

items.criterion: Count number of Download files listed for the latest displayed release
items.description: Navigate to the 'Download files' section for the same latest displayed release and report the number of files listed there (count only files for that release). Full credit if the count is correct and clearly tied to the latest release. Partial credit if the agent miscounts or includes files from other releases. Full credit if the list is not accessible/visible due to an uncontrollable blocker (site error, dynamic content not loading, missing section) and the agent explicitly reports the blocker/unavailability rather than inferring.

items.criterion: Respect constraints: no sign-in, no downloading/installing, no inference for missing metadata
items.description: Comply with task constraints by not signing in, not downloading or installing the package, and not inferring missing metadata. Full credit if the agent stays within these limits and explicitly marks any missing fields as unavailable. Partial credit for minor/borderline issues. No credit if the agent signs in, downloads/installs, or fabricates metadata.
